dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Hello, outlander. Please don't stay out on the street for too long.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why?

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Because of the Sakoku Decree, of course. Ritou is not doing well lately, and thieves are running rampant.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: You might get into trouble if you stay on the street for too long.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you might be...?

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: My name is Hiromi. As you can see, I work at the commission.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Please abide by the laws in Ritou, or you're going to make my job difficult, too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks for the reminder!

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Don't mention it, outlander.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Hello, Traveler. Do you need help with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Greetings!

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: I really appreciate what you did before.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Feel free to come find me if you need help with anything in Ritou. I will try my best to help!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About your big sister...

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: She... is not here yet. But since she and I have agreed to meet at Uyuu Restaurant, I'm sure that she will show up.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Anyway, I really appreciate your help. I will cherish the opportunity this time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Goodbye! All the best to you!

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Good day. When strolling through Ritou's streets, please keep your personal belongings safe at all times.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why's that?

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: The Sakoku Decree has been abolished, and the number of people coming to Ritou has increased greatly... and with that, incidents of thievery have also gone up.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: As such, I'm making sure to advise those I meet to watch out for their belongings.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: My name is Hiromi. As you can see, I work at the commission.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Please abide by the laws in Ritou, or you're going to make my job difficult, too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks for the reminder!

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: You're welcome.
